verdict_detail: Version seven still does not bind the legacy confirmed-items list exception to the unique frozen review directory path. An exact byte-for-byte copy of the frozen review pair placed in a different temporary directory with the same final directory name was accepted as passed. The requested fail-closed governance condition is therefore not satisfied.

must_fix.finding: The exception checks only path.parent.name, path.name and the SHA-256 digest. It does not compare the normalized parent directory path with the unique frozen results/23_hbv_multilead_joint_uncertainty/parameter_identification_validation_v01_reviews directory. In a direct replay, independent_review.json and independent_review_validation.json were copied byte-for-byte into C:/Users/yiqun/AppData/Local/Temp/v07_same_name_exact_copy_mg83_t1s/parameter_identification_validation_v01_reviews. The copied independent_review_validation.json retained SHA-256 b512dace4e24cc7e091ef322c589c116241876d44f84e738a04b5091f5f73b3b, and _review_status returned passed=true, required_fix_count=0, second_review_must_fix_count=0, contradictions_found=0 and unverified_items=0.
must_fix.impact: A copied legacy review outside the frozen evidence directory can still activate the only non-object confirmed-items exception and be counted as a passing independent review chain. This can incorrectly support numerical_chain_validated=true, so the governance conclusion cannot be signed off. The frozen numerical results inspected here are not changed by this parser defect.
must_fix.required_repair: Pass the unique authorized frozen review directory identity into the parser and require the resolved review directory to equal the canonical repository path results/23_hbv_multilead_joint_uncertainty/parameter_identification_validation_v01_reviews, while also retaining the exact independent_review_validation.json filename and SHA-256 b512dace4e24cc7e091ef322c589c116241876d44f84e738a04b5091f5f73b3b checks. Do not authorize the exception from a basename match alone.
acceptance_tests: An exact byte-for-byte copy of the complete frozen review directory at any other path, including a directory with the same final name, is rejected.
A different directory, same-name directory with fake content, same-structure content, and one-byte mutation are each rejected.

All earlier version-one through version-six governance counterexamples, the version-five ten active mutations, the version-six thirty-six active mutations, and all thirty-five formal tests pass after repair.
